en: The image shows a vintage postcard depicting a tree-lined avenue with people walking along the sidewalk and an old streetcar or tram in the distance. There are tall leafy trees bordering the street. On the right border, there is an illustration of exotic banana or palm plants. At the top, it reads 'Lourenço Marques Delagoa Bay.' At the bottom, 'Avenida Dom Manoel' is written, and on the left, the publisher's information is printed. The postcard has an antique, sepia-toned aesthetic.
